title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, starting with the first loop. In this loop, draw the first circle with its center located at coordinates (0.0233, 0.0233) and a radius of 0.0233 units. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0467. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This process will generate a new solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical base will be 0.04666666666666666 units in length, 0.04666666666666666 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius
r = r.center(0.0233, 0.0233).circle(0.0233)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylindrical shape
r = r.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · 1 sample
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0233, 0.0233)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0233)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# The part is a simple cylinder (rod)
# Bounding box: X 0.0466, Y 0.0466, Z 0.7500
# Top view shows a circle, front/right views show tall rectangles,
# isometric confirms a plain cylindrical rod.

diameter = 0.0466
radius = diameter / 2.0
height = 0.7500

# Sketch the circular profile on the XY plane and extrude along Z
r = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(radius).extrude(height)
